events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

That's a reasonable thing to ask before sharing your details. I'm an automated AI assistant, not a person. I run the IT helpdesk chat for Halcyon Components on behalf of the IT service desk. I can't share which AI vendor or model powers this service.

**What I can do:** reset passwords and look up support tickets. If you give me your employee ID, I'll start a reset and a reset link will go to the phone number on file for you. Your employee ID is all I need, so please don't send your old password or any other credentials.

**If you'd rather talk to a person:** you can call the service desk at **extension 4400**, 7am to 7pm.

If you'd like to continue here, just send your employee ID.
